name: altertable
description: Connects ChatGPT and Codex to Altertable's governed lakehouse for catalog discovery, semantic context, DuckDB SQL, and analytics workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Query Altertable catalogs and governed lakehouse data.
interface.longDescription: Use Altertable as a governed data source in ChatGPT and Codex. Discover catalogs, inspect schemas and semantic definitions, run read-only DuckDB SQL, and provide evidence for analysis and dashboards.
defaultPrompt: Use Altertable to list available catalogs, tables, and semantic definitions.
Use Altertable to explain this month's metrics with read-only DuckDB SQL.
Use Altertable as the data source for an adoption and retention dashboard.
